# `transfer` dialect

CEIR-13b sec-50 ceir.transfer: complete data-movement semantics -- copy (buffer/image/buffer-image/image-buffer, and SUBRESOURCE copies via VIEW operands -- shipped), clear, mip generation, upload (host->device), readback (device->host). HOST-authorable op vocabulary (ADR-0109): the ops live in crd-ceir; the crd-ceir-gpu BRIDGE lowers them onto the canonical command model / IComputeContext at CEIR-13d (core NEVER links gpu-context -- I3/I4). ⛔ effects are STATIC per-op-kind (a copy ALWAYS reads src / writes dst -- unlike ceir.compute's per-instance ambient baseline: there is no per-instance access here to defer): copy = Write{dst} + Read{src}, upload/clear = Write{dst}, readback = Read{src}, mip_gen = ReadWrite{image}. So a transfer HAZARDS its neighbours PRECISELY (the upload->first-read barrier scar is Write{dst}-then-Read{dst} = RAW, by construction) and -- unlike a dispatch -- does NOT extend an UNRELATED resource's 12c live range (the effect names a specific operand, never the whole Memory class). All ops RESULTLESS (host materialization for readback is provider-side; the sec-129 oracle compares OUTSIDE the IR). Well-formedness rides the module-walk verifier Context::find_transfer_misuse. ⛔ KNOWN HOLE (struck-in-place at 12c, retrofit named-forward): a transfer through a VIEW escapes ops_hazard today (distinct SSA Values assumed non-aliasing); 13b does not widen it but makes it easier to hit -- transfers through views are natural. ⛔ NO-FOLLOW (named, never silently subset): sec-50's tensor copy + blit + resolve + peer copy + sparse page mapping/upload + compression/decompression -> CEIR-13+/26; a TYPED image clear (this slice's `value` is the buffer FILL WORD only) -> CEIR-13d/render (aligns with RAH-1a.1's typed clear: clear_kind Float|Uint + clear_uint).

**5 ops:** `clear`, `copy`, `mip_gen`, `readback`, `upload`

transfer.clear(%dst) {value=N}. Static effect: MemoryWrite{dst}. find_transfer_misuse: dst transferable -> value kind-fold (ClearValueInvalid if present + non-Int) -> value placement (ClearValueOnImage if present + dst underlying is Image).
